units.source_text: 翌年春假，父亲在国民取外披了件袈裟造访叔父家来了。

en.t: During spring vacation the following year, my father came to visit my uncle's house wearing a priest's robe over his national uniform.

units.source_text: 他说，要带我到京都去两三天。

en.t: He said he wanted to take me to Kyoto for two or three days.

units.source_text: 那时候，父亲的肺病已经相当严重，身体十分最弱。

en.t: By then, my father's lung disease was already quite serious, and his body was extremely weak.

units.source_text: 不仅是我，连叔父婶母也都劝说父亲取消京都之行，父亲就是不听从。

en.t: Not only I, but also my uncle and aunt urged my father to cancel the trip to Kyoto, but he simply would not listen.

units.source_text: 事后回想起来，原来是父亲想趁自己还活着的时候，把我介绍给金阁寺的住持。

en.t: Looking back afterward, I realized that my father had wanted to introduce me to the abbot of Kinkakuji while he was still alive.
